en-US.longDescription:
Viewer for digital tachograph files
Key features
- Browse contents of digital tachograph files
- Data signatures confirmed
- Compatible with both Digital Tachograph and Smart Tachograph files
- Opens .DDD, .C1B, .V1B & .TGD files
en-US.name: Tachograph File Viewer
